releaseNotes: Adds a View on Altmetric link to each paper that has a DOI, PubMed ID or arXiv ID; it opens the paper's Altmetric page in your browser. Version 1.6.0 added posters and talks linked to grants. Link a poster or talk to the grants that supported it, record who presented it and mark it Student-led. Each grant page lists its posters and talks, and a CV setting can list them under each grant. Also includes the first parts of iCloud sync, which is not switched on yet.
